output.text: This fictional banknote centers a woven sun, symbolizing shared work through intricate, interlaced threads. The reverse bears nine square windows, each representing a unique district in the imagined city—architectural fragments of civic life. A violet border encircles the note, lending it visual cohesion and symbolic depth. The woven sun glows subtly under light, emphasizing unity and collective effort. Each window is precisely etched, suggesting transparency and hidden stories. The design prioritizes clarity and precision for illustrators crafting film props. The violet border frames the composition, anchoring the symbolic elements. This currency is not merely exchangeable—it is a narrative artifact, where every detail reflects community and purpose.
